> आरे । गोहा । नृहा । वधः । वः । अस्तु । सुम्नेभिः । अस्मे इति । वसवः । नमध्वं ॥ १७ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> मरुतो नोऽस्मभ्यं दशस्यंतो धनानि प्रयच्छंतः सुमेके सुरूपे रोदसी द्यावापृथिव्यौ वरिवस्यंतः स्वमहिम्ना पूरयंतो मृळंतु । मृळयंतु । अस्मान्सुखयुक्तान् कुर्वंतु । अपि च हे वसवो वासका मरुतः गोहा गवां मेघस्थानामुदकानां भेदको नृहा नृणां शत्रूणां हंता वो युष्मदीयं वध आयुधमारेऽस्तु । अस्मत्तो दूरे भवतु । यूयमपि सुम्नेभिः सुम्नैः सुखैः सहास्मे अस्मासु नमध्वं । स्वयमेवाभिमुखा भवत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

May the Maruts, giving (दशस्यंतः (*daśasyaṃtaḥ*)) us wealth and filling by their own greatness the beautiful heaven and earth (रोदसी (*rodasī*)), make us happy (मृळंतु (*mṛḷaṃtu*)). And, O Vasus, the dwellers-bestowers, Maruts: your weapon, which splits (गोहा (*gohā*)) the water-bearing clouds and slays (नृहा (*nṛhā*)) enemy men, let it be far from us. And you also, with blessings (सुम्नेभिः (*sumnebhiḥ*), pleasures), bow down (नमध्वं (*namadhvaṃ*)) to us, that is, of your own accord turn towards us.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—the Maruts
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- दशस्यंतः (*daśasyaṃtaḥ*)—giving wealth and so on
- सुमेके (*sumeke*)—of excellent form
- रोदसी (*rodasī*)—heaven and earth
- वरिवस्यंतः (*varivasyaṃtaḥ*)—filling with their powers
- मृळंतु (*mṛḷaṃtu*)—let them make us happy
- वसवः (*vasavaḥ*)—O Maruts, givers of dwelling
- गोहा (*gohā*)—that which splits the cloud and pours down water
- नृहा (*nṛhā*)—and destroys hostile people
- वः वधः (*vaḥ vadhaḥ*)—your weapon
- आरे अस्तु (*āre astu*)—let it be far from us
- सुम्नेभिः (*sumnebhiḥ*)—with your means of happiness
- अस्मे (*asme*)—to us
- नमध्वं (*namadhvaṃ*)—come with regard

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May the Maruts, giving us wealth and filling with their powers heaven and earth of attractive form, make us happy. O Maruts, givers of dwelling, let your weapon, which splits the cloud and pours down water and destroys hostile people, be far from us. O Maruts, come to us of your own accord with your means of happiness.

### Printed p. 358

##### English translation
May the munificent Maruts, filling the beautiful heaven and earth with their glory, make us happy : your fatal weapon, the render of clouds, the destroyer of men, be far from us : bend down to us, Vasus with blessings.

#### Ṛk 18

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> आ वो॒ होता॑ जोहवीति स॒त्तः स॒त्राचीं॑ रा॒तिं म॑रुतो गृणा॒नः ।  
> य ईव॑तो वृषणो॒ अस्ति॑ गो॒पाः सो अद्व॑यावी हवते व उ॒क्थैः ॥ १८ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> आ । वः । होता । जोहवीति । सत्तः । सत्राची । रातिं । मरुतः । गृणानः ।  
> यः । ईवतः । वृषणः । अस्ति । गोपाः । सः । अद्वयावी । हवते । वः । उक्थैः ॥ १८ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> मारुते पशावा वो होतेत्येषानुवाक्या । सूत्रितं च आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय । आ. ३-२ । इति ॥
> हे मरुतः सत्तो होतृषदने निषण्णोऽस्मदीयो होता सत्राचीं सर्वतो गमनशीलां रातिं त्वदीयं दानं गृणानः स्तुवन् वो युष्माना जोहवीति । भृशमाह्वयति । हे वृषणः कामानां वर्षितारो मरुतः यो होतेवतो गच्छतो व्यापारवतो यजमानस्य गोपा अस्ति युष्मदाह्वाननिमित्तेन रक्षको भवति स होताद्वयावी मायारहितः सन्नो युष्मानुक्थैः स्तोत्रैर्हवते । स्तौति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

In the animal sacrifice to the Maruts, the verse वो होता (*vo hotā*) is the anuvākyā. It is stated in the sūtra: आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय (*ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya*) (Ā. 3-2).
O Maruts, our hotṛ, seated (सत्तः (*sattaḥ*)) in the hotṛ's seat, praising your gift (रातिं (*rātiṃ*)) that goes everywhere (सत्राचीं (*satrācīṃ*)), calls you again and again (जोहवीति (*johavīti*)). O showerers of desires, Maruts: the hotṛ who is the guardian of the active, labouring sacrificer, becoming protector through calling you, and free from deceit (अद्वयावी (*advayāvī*)), praises you with hymns (उक्थैः (*ukthaiḥ*)).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- सत्तः (*sattaḥ*)—seated in his own place
- होता (*hotā*)—the hotṛ
- सत्राचीं (*satrācīṃ*)—pervading everywhere
- रातिं (*rātiṃ*)—and given by you, the gift
- गृणानः (*gṛṇānaḥ*)—praising
- वः (*vaḥ*)—you
- आ जोहवीति (*ā johavīti*)—calls again and again
- वृषणः (*vṛṣaṇaḥ*)—O Maruts, showerers of desires
- यः (*yaḥ*)—which hotṛ
- ईवतः (*īvataḥ*)—to the sacrificer engaged in rites
- गोपाः अस्ति (*gopāḥ asti*)—is protector
- सः (*saḥ*)—that same hotṛ
- अद्वयावी (*advayāvī*)—without deceit
- वः (*vaḥ*)—you
- उक्थैः (*ukthaiḥ*)—with hymns
- हवते (*havate*)—praises

### Printed p. 359

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, the hotṛ seated in his appointed place, praising the gift that pervades everywhere and is given by you, calls you again and again. O showerers of desires, Maruts, the hotṛ who is the protector of the sacrificer engaged in rites, being without any deceit, praises you with hymns.

##### English translation
Praising your universal liberality, Maruts, the ministrant priest repeatedly worships you seated (in the sacrificial chamber) : he, showerers (of benefits), who is the guardian of the zealous (worshipper), he, (the priest) who is void of insincerity, glorifies you with hymns.

##### विशेषविषयगळु (Special Topics)

In the animal sacrifice offered to the Maruts, this Ṛk beginning आ वो होता (*ā vo hotā*) is to be recited as the anuvākyā mantra; this is explained by the sūtra of the Āśvalāyana-śrauta-sūtra आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः प्र चित्रमर्कं गृणते तुराय (*ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ pra citramarkaṃ gṛṇate turāya*) (Ā. 3-2).

#### Ṛk 19

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> इ॒मे तु॒रं म॒रुतो॑ रमयंती॒मे सहः॒ सह॑स॒ आ न॑मंति ।  
> इ॒मे शंसं॑ वनुष्य॒तो नि पां॑ति गु॒रु द्वेषो॒ अर॑रुषे दधंति ॥ १९ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> इमे । तुरं । मरुतः । रमयंति । इमे । सहः । सहसः । आ । नमंति ।  
> इमे । शंसं । वनुष्यतः । नि । पांति । गुरु । द्वेषः । अररुषे । दधंति ॥ १९ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> इम ईदृशो मरुतस्तुरं कर्मसु क्षिप्रवंतं यजमानं रमयंति । क्रीडयंति । इमे मरुतः सहः सहसा बलेन सहसो बलवतो जनाना नमंति । इमे मरुतो वनुष्यतो हिंसकात्पुरुषाच्छंसं शंसकं स्तोतारं नि पांति । नितरां पालयंति । अररुषे हविरप्रयच्छते जनाय गुरु महद्द्वेषोऽप्रियं दधंति । कुर्वंति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

These Maruts give delight (रमयंति (*ramayaṃti*): make sport) to the sacrificer (तुरं (*turaṃ*)) who is quick in rites. These Maruts bend down (नमंति (*namaṃti*)) the strength of strong people by their own strength (सहः (*sahaḥ*)). These Maruts protect (नि पांति (*ni pāṃti*)) fully the praiser from the violent man. For the person who gives no oblation (अररुषे (*araruṣe*)) they produce (दधंति (*dadhaṃti*)) great displeasure, that is, what is disagreeable.

### Printed p. 360

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- इमे मरुतः (*ime marutaḥ*)—these Maruts
- तुरं (*turaṃ*)—the sacrificer devoted to rites
- रमयंति (*ramayaṃti*)—make glad
- इमे (*ime*)—these Maruts
- सहः (*sahaḥ*)—by their strength
- सहसः (*sahasaḥ*)—people possessed of strength
- आ नमंति (*ā namaṃti*)—humble
- इमे (*ime*)—these Maruts
- वनुष्यतः (*vanuṣyataḥ*)—from the violent enemy
- शंसं (*śaṃsaṃ*)—the praiseworthy praiser
- नि पांति (*ni pāṃti*)—protect fully
- अररुषे (*araruṣe*)—to people who do not give
- गुरु (*guru*)—great
- द्वेषः (*dveṣaḥ*)—evil
- दधंति (*dadhaṃti*)—do

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

These Maruts make glad the sacrificer devoted to rites. By their strength they humble strong enemy people. These same Maruts fully protect the praiseworthy praiser from the violent enemy. To the miserly, who do not give, they do great evil.

##### English translation
These, Maruts, give pleasure to the zealous (worshipper) : these humble the strength of the strong man : these protect their adorers from the malignant : they entertain severe displeasure towards the withholder of offerings.

#### Ṛk 20

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> इ॒मे र॒ध्रं चि॑न्म॒रुतो॑ जुनंति॒ भृमिं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ वस॑वो जु॒षंत॑े ।  
> अप॑ बाधध्वं वृषण॒स्तमां॑सि ध॒त्त विश्वं॒ तन॑यं तो॒कम॒स्मे ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> इमे । रध्रं । चित् । मरुतः । जुनंति । भृमिं । चित् । यथा । वसवः । जुषंत ।  
> अप । बाधध्वं । वृषणः । तमांसि । धत्त । विश्वं । तनयं । तोकं । अस्मे इति ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> इमे मरुतो रध्रं चित् समृद्धमपि जनं जुनंति । प्रेरयंति । भृमिं चित् भ्रमणशीलमपि दरिद्रं जुनंति । प्रेरयंति । वसवो वासका देवा युष्मान्यथा जुषंते कामयेरन् हे वृषणः कामानां वर्षितारः के यूयं तमांस्यप बा-

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

These Maruts impel (जुनंति (*junaṃti*)) even a prosperous man (रध्रं चित् (*radhraṃ cit*)), and impel even a wandering, poor man (भृमिं चित् (*bhṛmiṃ cit*)). The Vasus, the dwelling-giving gods, as they may desire you (जुषंते (*juṣaṃte*)), O showerers of desires ….

### Printed p. 361

> धध्वं । नाशयत । अपि चास्मे अस्मभ्यं विश्वं बहुलं तोकं पुत्रं तनयं पौत्रं च धत्त । प्रयच्छत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

Sāyaṇa completes the gloss begun in the previous window: बाधध्वं (*bādhadhvaṃ*) means "destroy". He adds that the Maruts should also grant to us (अस्मे (*asme*) = अस्मभ्यं (*asmabhyaṃ*)) much (विश्वं (*viśvaṃ*) = बहुलं (*bahulaṃ*)) offspring: तोकं (*tokaṃ*) is a son, तनयं (*tanayaṃ*) a grandson; धत्त (*dhatta*) means प्रयच्छत (*prayacchata*), "give".

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- इमे मरुतः (*ime marutaḥ*)—these Maruts
- रध्रं चित् (*radhraṃ cit*)—the man grown rich in wealth
- जुनंति (*junaṃti*)—they impel
- भृमिं चित् (*bhṛmiṃ cit*)—even the poor man they impel and give encouragement
- वृषणः (*vṛṣaṇaḥ*)—O Maruts, showerers of desires
- यथा (*yathā*)—in what manner
- वसवः (*vasavaḥ*)—the gods who give dwelling
- जुषंते (*juṣaṃte*)—desire your work, in that manner
- तमांसि (*tamāṃsi*)—the darknesses
- अप बाधध्वं (*apa bādhadhvaṃ*)—destroy
- अस्मे (*asme*)—to us
- विश्वं (*viśvaṃ*)—in abundance
- तोकं (*tokaṃ*)—sons
- तनयं (*tanayaṃ*)—grandsons
- धत्त (*dhatta*)—give

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

In the way these Maruts impel the man grown rich in wealth, they impel the poor man too and rouse him. O Maruts, showerers of desires, as the gods who give dwelling desire your work, so destroy the darknesses. Give us sons and grandsons in abundance.

##### English translation
These, Maruts, encourage the prosperous man : they encourage the (poor) wanderer : they, as Vasus, are pleased (with you): showerers (of benefits), dissipate the darkness : grant us many sons and grandsons.

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> मा वो॑ दा॒त्रान्म॑रुतो॒ निर॑राम॒ मा प॒श्चाद्द॑घ्न रथ्यो विभा॒गे ।  
> आ नः॑ स्पा॒र्हे भ॑जतना वस॒व्ये॒३॒॑ यदीं॑ सुजा॒तं वृ॑षणो वो॒ अस्ति॑ ॥ २१ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> मा । वः । दात्रात् । मरुतः । निः । अराम । मा । पश्चात् । दघ्म । रथ्यः । विभागे ।  
> आ । नः । स्पार्हे । भजतन । वसव्ये । यत् । ईं । सुजातं । वृषणः । वः । अस्ति ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः वो युष्माकं दात्राद्दानान्निरराम । वयं मा निर्गमाम । यूयमस्मान्सरित्यक्त्वान्येभ्यो धनं मा दत्तेत्यर्थः । हे रथ्यो रथवंतो
> 46

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

"O Maruts, may we not depart (निरराम (*nirarāma*)) from your gift (दात्रात् (*dātrāt*))": that is, do not abandon us and give wealth to others. O Maruts, lords of chariots (रथ्यः (*rathyaḥ*))…

### Printed p. 362

> मरुतः विभागे युष्मदीयस्य धनस्य दाने पश्चान्मा दघ्न । दघ्नैतिर्गतिकर्मा । वयं पश्चाद्भागिनो मा भूम । यूयं प्रथममस्मभ्यमेव दत्तेति यावत् । स्पार्हे स्पृहणीये वसव्ये धनसमूहे यूयं नोऽस्माना भजतन । भागिनः कुरुत । हे वृषणो वर्षितारो मरुतः वो युष्माकं सुजातं शोभनजननं यद्वसव्यमस्ति तस्मिन्नस्मान्भागिनः कुरुतेति संबंधः । ईमिति पूरणः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

…do not leave us behind (दघ्न (*daghna*); दघ्न (*daghna*) is a root of motion) in the apportionment (विभागे (*vibhāge*)) of your wealth. May we not be latecomers to a share; give first to us. Make us partakers (भजतन (*bhajatana*)) in the desirable (स्पार्हे (*spārhe*)) mass of wealth (वसव्ये (*vasavye*)). O showering Maruts, whatever well-born (सुजातं (*sujātaṃ*), of good birth) wealth is yours, in that make us sharers. ईं (*īṃ*) is a filler.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- दात्रात् (*dātrāt*)—from the gift
- मा निरराम (*mā nirarāma*)—may we not be left free of (excluded)
- रथ्यः (*rathyaḥ*)—O Maruts, lords of chariots
- विभागे (*vibhāge*)—in the receiving of your gift
- पश्चात् मा दघ्म (*paścāt mā daghma*)—do not make us sharers of the last portion
- स्पार्हे (*spārhe*)—greatly desired
- वसव्ये (*vasavye*)—extensive; to the mass of wealth
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- आ भजतन (*ā bhajatana*)—make us sharers
- वृषणः (*vṛṣaṇaḥ*)—O Maruts, showerers of desires
- वः (*vaḥ*)—belonging to you
- सुजातं (*sujātaṃ*)—excellent, full of people
- यत् अस्ति (*yat asti*)—whatever wealth of yours there is, in that make us sharers

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, never withhold your gift from us. O Maruts, lords of chariots, in receiving your gift do not make us sharers of the last portion. Make us sharers in the greatly desired, abundant mass of wealth. O Maruts, showerers of desires, make us sharers in whatever wealth of yours there is, belonging to you and full of excellent people.

##### English translation
Never, Maruts, may we be excluded from your bounty : let us not, lordsof chariots, be lost in its apportionment : make us sharers in that desirable opulence which, showerers (of benefits), is born of you.

#### Ṛk 22

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> सं यद्धनं॑त म॒न्युभि॒र्जना॑सः॒ शूरा॑ य॒ह्वेष्वोष॑धीषु वि॒क्षु ।  
> अध॑ स्मा नो मरुतो रुद्रियासस्त्रा॒तारो॑ भूत॒ पृत॑नास्व॒र्यः ॥ २२ ॥

### Printed p. 363

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> सं । यत् । हनंत । मन्युभिः । जनासः । शूराः । यह्वीषु । ओषधीषु । विक्षु ।  
> अध । स्म । नः । मरुतः । रुद्रियासः । त्रातारः । भूत । पृतनासु । अर्यः ॥ २२ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यद्यदा शूरा विक्रांता जनासो जना यह्वीषु महतीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु प्रजासु च जेतव्यासु मन्युभिः कोपैरभिमान्यैर्वा सं हनंते संगच्छंते अध तदानीं हे रुद्रियासो रुद्रपुत्रा हे मरुतः यूयं पृतनासु युद्धेष्वर्योऽरेः शत्रोः सकाशान्नोऽस्माकं त्रातारो भूत । रक्षका भवत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

When (यत् (*yat*)) valiant men (शूराः (*śūrāḥ*), जनासः (*janāsaḥ*)) come together (सं हनंते (*saṃ hanaṃte*) = संगच्छंते (*saṃgacchaṃte*)) with wrath or pride (मन्युभिः (*manyubhiḥ*)) for the great (यह्वीषु (*yahvīṣu*)) plants (ओषधीषु (*oṣadhīṣu*)) and the peoples (विक्षु (*vikṣu*)) that are to be conquered, then, O Maruts, sons of Rudra (रुद्रियासः (*rudriyāsaḥ*)), be our protectors in battles (पृतनासु (*pṛtanāsu*)) from the enemy (अर्यः (*aryaḥ*) = *areḥ śatroḥ*).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- रुद्रियासः (*rudriyāsaḥ*)—sons of Rudra
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- पृतनासु (*pṛtanāsu*)—in battles
- यत् (*yat*)—when
- शूराः (*śūrāḥ*)—valiant
- जनासः (*janāsaḥ*)—men
- यह्वीषु (*yahvīṣu*)—great
- ओषधीषु (*oṣadhīṣu*)—among plants
- विक्षु (*vikṣu*)—and among peoples, in order to conquer the wealth that is there
- मन्युभिः (*manyubhiḥ*)—together with their wrath
- सं हनंत (*saṃ hanaṃta*)—gather together
- अध (*adha*)—at that time
- अर्यः (*aryaḥ*)—from the enemy
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- त्रातारः (*trātāraḥ*)—as protectors
- भूत (*bhūta*)—be

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, sons of Rudra, when in battles valiant men gather together with their wrath to conquer the great plants and the peoples, at that time protect us from the enemy.

##### English translation
When heroic men filled with wrath, assemble for(the sake of conquering) many plants and people, then Maruts, sons of Rudra, be our defenders in battles against our enemies.

#### Ṛk 23

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> भूरि॑ चक्र मरुतः॒ पित्र्या॑ण्यु॒क्थानि॒ या वः॑ श॒स्यंते॑ पु॒रा चि॑त् ।  
> म॒रुद्भि॑रु॒ग्रः पृत॑नासु॒ साळ्हा॑ म॒रुद्भि॒रित्सनि॑ता॒ वाज॒मर्वा॑ ॥ २३ ॥

### Printed p. 364

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> भूरि । चक्र । मरुतः । पित्र्याणि । उक्थानि । या । वः । शस्यंते । पुरा । चित् ।  
> मरुत्भिः । उग्रः । पृतनासु । साळ्हा । मरुत्भिः । इत् । सनिता । वाजं । अर्वा ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः यूयं भूरि भूरीणि बहूनि पित्र्याण्यस्मत्पितृसंबंधीनि धनदानादीनि कर्माणि चक्र । कृतवंतो भवत । पुरा चित् पूर्वकालेऽपि वो युष्माकमुक्थानि प्रशस्यानि यानि कर्माणि प्रशस्यंते प्रख्यायंते तानि चक्रेति संबंधः । उग्र ओजस्वी पृतनासु युद्धेषु मरुद्भिर्युष्माभिरेव हेतुभिः साळ्हा शत्रूणामभिभविता भवति । मरुद्भिरिन्मरुद्भिर्युष्माभिरेव हेतुभिरर्वा स्तोत्रैरभिगंता वाजमन्नं सनिता संभक्ता भवति । यद्वा । अर्वाश्वो वाजं युद्धं सनिता भवति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, you have performed (चक्र (*cakra*)) many (भूरि (*bhūri*)) deeds, such as gifts of wealth, that concern (पित्र्याणि (*pitryāṇi*)) our fathers. Also in former times the praiseworthy (उक्थानि (*ukthāni*)) works of yours that are proclaimed (शस्यंते (*śasyaṃte*)) you have done. The mighty man (उग्रः (*ugraḥ*)) becomes the vanquisher (साळ्हा (*sāḷhā*)) of enemies in battles by you, the Maruts, as the cause. By the Maruts alone the worshipper who approaches (अर्वा (*arvā*)) with hymns becomes a sharer (सनिता (*sanitā*)) of food (वाजं (*vājaṃ*)). Or else: the horse (अर्वा (*arvā*)) becomes the winner of the contest (वाजं (*vājaṃ*) = battle).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- पुरा चित् (*purā cit*)—in former times too
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- या उक्थानि शस्यंते (*yā ukthāni śasyaṃte*)—those works which were praiseworthy
- भूरि (*bhūri*)—abundant
- पित्र्याणि (*pitryāṇi*)—favoured to our fathers and others: such works of giving and the like
- चक्र (*cakra*)—you have accomplished
- उग्रः (*ugraḥ*)—one of great strength
- पृतनासु (*pṛtanāsu*)—in battles
- मरुद्भिः (*marudbhiḥ*)—together with the Maruts
- साळ्हा (*sāḷhā*)—becomes able to conquer enemies
- अर्वा (*arvā*)—the worshipper who approaches with praises
- मरुद्भिरित् (*marudbhirit*)—by the help of the Maruts alone
- वाजं (*vājaṃ*)—of food
- सनिता (*sanitā*)—becomes a sharer

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, those praiseworthy works, the gifts and the like beneficial to all our fathers, which you did in the past, are still praised now. Only with your help can the mighty man conquer enemies. Only the worshipper who approaches the Maruts with hymns becomes a sharer of food, by the help of the Maruts.

##### English translation
You have bestowed, Maruts, many (benefits) on our forefathers, which praiseworthy (benefits) have been celebrated in former times : by the (favour of the) Maruts the fierce (warrior) is victorious in combats : by the (favour of the) Maruts the worshipper ever obtains food.

#### Ṛk 24

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अ॒स्मे वी॒रो म॑रुतः शु॒ष्म्य॑स्तु॒ जना॑नां॒ यो असु॑रो विध॒र्ता ।  
> अ॒पो येन॑ सुक्षि॒तये॒ तरे॒माध॒ स्वमोको॑ अ॒भि वः॑ स्याम ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> अस्मे इति । वीरः । मरुतः । शुष्मी । अस्तु । जनानां । यः । असुरः । विधर्ता ।  
> अपः । येन । सुक्षितये । तरेम । अध । स्वं । ओकः । अभि । वः । स्याम ॥ ४४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः अस्मे अस्माकं वीरः पुत्रः शुष्म्यस्तु । बलवान्भवतु । असुरः प्र-ज्ञावान्यो जनानां शत्रूणां विधर्ता विधारकः । येन पुत्रेण वयं सुक्षितये सुष्ठु निवासायाप अप्नुवतः शत्रूंस्तरेम हिंसेम । स पुत्रो बलवानस्त्विति पूर्वेणान्वयः । अथापि च वो युष्मदीया वयं स्वमोक आत्मीयं स्थानमभि स्याम । अतिस्याम ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, let our son (वीरः (*vīraḥ*)) be strong (शुष्म्यस्तु (*śuṣmyastu*) = बलवान्भवतु (*balavānbhavatu*)), wise (असुरः (*asuraḥ*) = प्रज्ञावान् (*prajñāvān*)), the one who holds apart (विधर्ता (*vidhartā*) = विधारकः (*vidhārakaḥ*)) hostile men (जनानां (*janānāṃ*) = शत्रूणां (*śatrūṇāṃ*)), by whom we may cross (तरेम (*tarema*) = हिंसेम (*hiṃsema*), "may we harm") the enemies who pervade (अपः (*apaḥ*) = अप्नुवतः (*apnuvataḥ*)) for the sake of good dwelling (सुक्षितये (*sukṣitaye*)). Let that son be strong: this is the connection with the first part. And then may we, yours, reach (अभि स्याम (*abhi syāma*) = अतिस्याम (*atisyāma*)) our own abode (स्वं ओकः (*svaṃ okaḥ*)).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- अस्मे (*asme*)—our
- असुरः (*asuraḥ*)—wise
- यः (*yaḥ*)—whichever son of ours
- जनानां (*janānāṃ*)—to enemy men
- विधर्ता (*vidhartā*)—is a restrainer
- येन (*yena*)—by whose help
- सुक्षितये (*sukṣitaye*)—for the gaining of a good home
- अपः (*apaḥ*)—the pervading enemy
- तरेम (*tarema*)—we may be able to harm; such a
- वीरः (*vīraḥ*)—heroic son
- शुष्मी (*śuṣmī*)—as one endowed with strength
- अस्तु (*astu*)—let him be
- अध (*adha*)—and
- वः (*vaḥ*)—we who belong to you
- स्वं ओकः (*svaṃ okaḥ*)—our own dwelling-houses
- अभि स्याम (*abhi syāma*)—may we reach

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, let our heroic son be endowed with strength. Increase the strength of such a son of ours, the wise one who is a restrainer of enemy men, by whose help we can destroy the enemy and obtain a good home. May we, your worshippers, reach our own dwelling-houses.

##### English translation
May our male progeny, Maruts, be vigorous, one who is intelligent, the scatterer of (hostile) men, by whom we may cross the water (of enmity) to a secure dwelling : may we, your (servants), dwell in our own abode.

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

This Ṛk has been explained before. As to the meaning of अप्स्वर (*apsvara*): let Indra and the other gods accept our hymn. Abiding in the proximity of the Maruts, may we be in happiness. O Maruts, protect us always with imperishable blessings (*avināśaiḥ*).**NOTE**

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- नः (*naḥ*)—our
- तत् (*tat*)—this hymn
- इंद्रः (*iṃdraḥ*)—Indra
- वरुणः (*varuṇaḥ*)—Varuṇa
- मित्रः (*mitraḥ*)—Mitra
- अग्निः (*agniḥ*)—Agni
- आपः (*āpaḥ*)—the water deities
- ओषधीः (*oṣadhīḥ*)—the plants

- जुषंत (*juṣaṃta*)—let them accept
- (वयं (*vayaṃ*)—we)
- मरुतां (*marutāṃ*)—of the Maruts
- उपस्थे (*upasthe*)—seated near
- शर्मन् (*śarman*)—in a happy home
- स्याम (*syāma*)—may we be

- सदा (*sadā*)—always
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- स्वस्तिभिः (*svastibhiḥ*)—with blessings
- पात (*pāta*)—protect

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni, the water deities, the plants and the trees accept this hymn of ours. May we, abiding near the Maruts, be in a happy home. O gods, always protect us with blessings.

##### English translation
May Indra, Varuna, Mitra, Agni, the waters, the plants, the trees, be pleased with us : may we recline in happiness upon the lap of the Maruts : and do you ever cherish us with blessings.

## Sūkta 57 (Maṇḍala 7)

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> मध्वो व इति सप्तर्चं द्वितीयं सूक्तं वसिष्ठस्यार्षं त्रैष्टुभं मरुद्देव-ताकं । मध्वः सप्तेत्यनुक्रांतं ॥ दशरात्रे षष्ठेऽहन्याग्निमारुत इदं मारुतनिवि-द्धानं । सूत्रितं च । मध्वो वो नाम स प्रत्नेत्याग्निमारुतं । आ. ८-८ । इति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

This is the second sūkta, of seven Ṛks, beginning मध्वो वः (*madhvo vaḥ*). Its seer is Vasiṣṭha, its deity the Maruts, its metre Triṣṭubh; the Anukramaṇī says मध्वः सप्त (*madhvaḥ sapta*). On the sixth day of the Daśarātra it is used as the nivid-dhāna (inserted hymn) in the Āgnimāruta Śastra. The sūtra says: मध्वो वो नाम स प्रत्नेत्याग्निमारुतं । आ. ८-८ । (*madhvo vo nāma sa pratnetyāgnimārutaṃ | ā. 8-8 |*) (Ā. Sū. 8-8).

##### Anuvāda

This sūkta beginning "मध्वो वः (*madhvo vaḥ*)" is the second sūkta in the fourth anuvāka. It has seven Ṛks. Vasiṣṭha is its seer; the Maruts are the deity; the metre is Triṣṭubh. In the Anukramaṇī it is described as "मध्वः सप्त (*madhvaḥ sapta*)". When the Āgnimāruta Śastras are recited on the sixth day of the sacrifice called Daśarātra, this sūkta is to be inserted and recited as the nivid-dhāna sūkta; the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra explains this by the sūtra "मध्वो वो नाम स प्रत्नेत्याग्निमारुतं (*madhvo vo nāma sa pratnetyāgnimārutaṃ*)" (Ā. 8-8).

Sūkta—57
Maṇḍala—7; Anuvāka—4; Sūkta—57
Aṣṭaka—5; Adhyāya—4; Varga—27
Ṛks in the sūkta—7
Seer: Vasiṣṭha
Deity: the Maruts
Metre: Triṣṭubh

#### Ṛk 1

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> मध्वो॑ वो॒ नाम॒ मारु॑तं यजत्राः॒ प्र य॒ज्ञेषु॒ शव॑सा मदंति ।  
> ये रे॒जयं॑ति॒ रोद॑सी चिदु॒र्वी पिन्वं॒त्युत्सं॒ यदया॑सुरु॒ग्राः ॥ १ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> मध्वः । वः । नाम । मारुतं । यजत्राः । प्र । यज्ञेषु । शवसा । मदंति ।  
> ये । रेजयंति । रोदसी इति । चित् । उर्वी इति । पिन्वंति । उत्सं । यत् । आयासुः । उग्राः ॥ १ ॥

### Printed p. 368

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे यजत्रा यजनीया मरुतः वो युष्मदीयं मारुतं मरुत्संबंधि नाम नामधेयं मध्वो मधवो मादयितारः स्तोतारो यज्ञेषु यागेषु शवसा बलेन प्र मदंति । प्रकर्षेण स्तुवंति । उच्चैः स्तुवंतीत्यर्थः । ये मरुत उर्वी विस्तीर्णे रोदसी चिद्द्यावापृथिव्यावपि रेजयंति कंपयंति किंचोत्सं मेघं पिन्वंति वर्षयंति उग्रा उद्गूर्णा यद्ये मरुतोऽयासुः यांति सर्वत्र गच्छंति । तेषां मरुतां युष्माकं नाम प्र मदंतीति पूर्वेणान्वयः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O adorable Maruts, the worshippers, who delight you, celebrate at sacrifices with strength your Marut-name, that is, they praise it loudly. They are those Maruts who make the spacious heaven and earth tremble, make the cloud rain, and, being fierce, go everywhere. The words "of you Maruts" are construed with "they celebrate your name" of the first part.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- यजत्राः (*yajatrāḥ*)—O revered Maruts
- ये (*ye*)—you who
- उर्वी (*urvī*)—vast
- रोदसी चित् (*rodasī cit*)—heaven and earth as well
- रेजयंति (*rejayaṃti*)—cause to tremble
- यत् (*yat*)—you who
- उग्राः (*ugrāḥ*)—being of exceeding strength
- आयासुः (*āyāsuḥ*)—roam everywhere
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- मारुतं (*mārutaṃ*)—relating to the Maruts
- नाम (*nāma*)—name
- मध्वः (*madhvaḥ*)—worshippers who give you delight
- यज्ञेषु (*yajñeṣu*)—at sacrifices
- शवसा (*śavasā*)—with strength
- प्र मदंति (*pra madaṃti*)—praise so as to give delight

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O worshipful Maruts, you who make the vast heaven and earth tremble and make the cloud cause rain, you who being of exceeding strength roam everywhere: that Marut-name of yours the worshippers, who give you delight, praise at the sacrifices with strength, so as to give delight.

##### English translation
Adorable (Maruts), the worshippers vigorously celebrate at sacrifices your appellation of company of the Maruts, they who cause the spacious heaven and earth to tremble, the clouds to rain, and move everywhere terrible.

#### Ṛk 2

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> नि॒चे॒तारो॒ हि म॒रुतो॑ गृ॒णंतं॑ प्रणे॒तारो॒ यज॑मानस्य॒ मन्म॑ ।  
> अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्य वि॒दथे॑षु ब॒र्हिरा वी॒तये॑ सदत पिप्रिया॒णाः ॥ २ ॥

### Printed p. 369

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> निचेतारः । हि । मरुतः । गृणंतं । प्रनेतारः । यजमानस्य । मन्म ।  
> अस्माकं । अद्य । विदथेषु । बर्हिः । आ । वीतये । सदत । पिप्रियाणाः ॥ २ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> ये मरुतो गृणंतं स्तुवंतं जनं निचेतारो हि मृगयमाणा भवंति खलु अपि च यजमानस्य मन्माभिमतं कामं प्रणेतारश्च भवंति । अपरोर्धर्चः प्रतीककृतः । हे मरुतः यूयं पिप्रियाणाः प्रीयमाणाः संतोऽद्यास्मिन्दिवसेऽस्माकं विदथेषु यज्ञेषु वीतये सोमस्य भक्षणाय बर्हिर्बर्हिषि कुशमये आ सदत । आसीदत । उपविशत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The Maruts are seekers of the person who praises them, and leaders to fulfilment of the sacrificer's desired wish (मन्म (*manma*)). The second half-verse is a pratīka. O Maruts, being pleased, sit today at our sacrifices (विदथेषु (*vidatheṣu*)) upon the kuśa grass, for partaking (वीतये (*vītaye*)) of the soma.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—the Maruts
- गृणंतं (*gṛṇaṃtaṃ*)—the person who praises
- निचेतारो हि (*nicetāro hi*)—go seeking
- यजमानस्य (*yajamānasya*)—of the sacrificer
- मन्म (*manma*)—the desired object
- प्रणेतारः (*praṇetāraḥ*)—fulfil
- (O Maruts) पिप्रियाणाः (*pipriyāṇāḥ*)—you who are pleased
- अद्य (*adya*)—on this day of the sacrifice
- अस्माकं (*asmākaṃ*)—our
- विदथेषु (*vidatheṣu*)—at sacrifices
- वीतये (*vītaye*)—for drinking soma
- बर्हिः (*barhiḥ*)—upon the seat of darbha grass
- आ सदत (*ā sadata*)—sit down

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

The Maruts go seeking their praisers and fulfil the sacrificer's desired wish. O Maruts, showing your affection, sit on this day of the sacrifice, at our sacrifices, upon the seat of darbha grass, for drinking soma.

##### English translation
The Maruts verily are the benefactors of him who praises them, the gratifiers of the wishes of the institutor of the solemnity : do you, being pleased, sit down to-day upon the grass at our ceremony, to partake (of the sacrificial food).

#### Ṛk 3

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> नैताव॑द॒न्ये म॒रुतो॒ यथे॒मे भ्राजं॑ते रु॒क्मैरायु॑धैस्त॒नूभिः॑ ।  
> आ रोद॑सी विश्व॒पिशः॑ पिशा॒नाः स॑मा॒नमं॒ज्यं॑जते शु॒भे कं ॥ ३ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

### Printed p. 370

> न । एतावत् । अन्ये । मरुतः । यथा । इमे । भ्राजंते । रुक्मैः । आयुधैः ।  
> तनूभिः ।  
> आ । रोदसी इति । विश्वपिशः । पिशानाः । समानं । अंजि । अंजते । शुभे । कं ॥ ३ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> इमे ईदृशा मरुतो यथा यत्परिमाणं धनादिकं ददति अन्ये मरुद्व्यतिरिक्ता देवा एतावद्धनादिकं न दद्युरित्यर्थः । ते च रुक्मै रोचिमानैराभरणैरायुधैः स्वकीयैस्तनूभिरात्मीयैः केवलैरंगैश्च भ्राजंते । सर्वदा भासंते । कश्चिदतिशयवाक्यतामाह । यथेमे मरुतो रुक्मादिभिर्भ्राजंते नैतावदन्ये देवा व्यतिरिक्ता भ्राजंते इति । अपि च रोदसी द्यावापृथिव्यौ पिशानाः प्रकाशयंतो विश्वपिशो व्याप्तदीप्तय एवंभूता मरुतः शुभे शोभायै समानं सदृशरूपमंज्याभरणमांजते । स्वकीयावयवेष्वभिव्यक्तीकुर्वंति । कमिति पूरणः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

These Maruts give wealth and the like in such measure that other gods, apart from the Maruts, would not give so much. They shine always with radiant ornaments, their weapons, and their own bodies, that is, with their bare limbs. Someone expresses the superlative: as these Maruts shine with gold ornaments and the rest, other gods do not shine so. Further, the Maruts, lighting up heaven and earth (रोदसी (*rodasī*)), with far-spread splendour (विश्वपिशः (*viśvapiśaḥ*)), put on for beauty (शुभे (*śubhe*)) a common, similar ornament, displaying it on their own limbs. कं (*kaṃ*) is a filler.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- इमे मरुतः (*ime marutaḥ*)—these Maruts
- यथा (*yathā*)—in the measure in which they give wealth and the like
- एतावत् (*etāvat*)—in that same measure
- अन्ये (*anye*)—other gods
- न (*na*)—do not give
- (they)
- रुक्मैः (*rukmaiḥ*)—golden-hued
- आयुधैः (*āyudhaiḥ*)—furnished with weapons
- तनूभिः (*tanūbhiḥ*)—with bodies
- भ्राजंते (*bhrājaṃte*)—shine
- रोदसी (*rodasī*)—heaven and earth
- पिशानाः (*piśānāḥ*)—making them shine
- विश्वपिशः (*viśvapiśaḥ*)—the Maruts, whose lustre is spread everywhere
- शुभे (*śubhe*)—for the adornment of their bodies
- समानं (*samānaṃ*)—of one form
- अंजि (*aṃji*)—ornament
- आ अंजते (*ā aṃjate*)—wear

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

In the measure in which the Maruts give wealth and the like to sacrificers, other gods do not give. They shine with bodies that are golden-hued and furnished with weapons. And the Maruts, making heaven and earth shine and having lustre spread everywhere, wear for the adornment of their bodies an ornament of one form.

##### English translation
No other (deities give) such (good things) as the Maruts, as they shine with brilliant (ornaments), weapons, and persons : illumining heaven and earth, wide radiating, they heighten their common lustre for (our) good,

#### Ṛk 4
### Printed p. 371

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> ऋध॒क्सा वो॑ मरुतो दि॒द्युद॑स्तु॒ यद्व॒ आगः॑ पुरु॒षता॒ करा॑म ।  
> मा व॒स्तस्या॒मपि॑ भूमा यजत्रा अ॒स्मे वो॑ अस्तु सुम॒तिश्चनि॑ष्ठा ॥ ४ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> ऋधक् । सा । वः । मरुतः । दिद्युत् । अस्तु । यत् । वः । आगः । पुरुषता । कराम ।  
> मा । वः । तस्यां । अपि । भूम । यजत्राः । अस्मे इति । वः । अस्तु । सुमतिः ।  
> चनिष्ठा ॥ ४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः वो युष्मदीया सा प्रसिद्धा दिद्युद्धेतिरृधगस्तु । अस्मत्तः पृथग्भवतु । यद्यदपि वयं वो युष्माकमागोऽपराधं पुरुषता पुरुषतया मनुष्यत्वेन कराम करवाम । मनुष्याणां हि प्रमादः सुलभ इत्यर्थः । हे यजत्रा यजनीया मरुतः वो युष्मदीयायां तस्यां दिद्युत्यपीषदसि मा भूम । चनिष्ठा अन्नवत्तमा । अतिशयेनान्नप्रदेत्यर्थः । वो युष्मदीया सुमतिरनुग्रहबुद्धिरस्मे अस्मास्वस्तु ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, may that well-known दिद्युत् (*didyut*), your missile, be apart (ऋधक् (*ṛdhak*)) from us, even if through human frailty (पुरुषता (*puruṣatā*)) we commit an offence against you; for error is easy for men. O adorable Maruts, may we not come into that missile of yours (as its victim). चनिष्ठा (*caniṣṭhā*) means richest in food, that is, bestowing food in abundance: may your favouring mind (सुमति (*sumati*)) be upon us.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- वः (*vaḥ*)—belonging to you
- सा (*sā*)—and well-known
- दिद्युत् (*didyut*)—weapon
- ऋधक् अस्तु (*ṛdhak astu*)—be far from us
- यजत्राः (*yajatrāḥ*)—O Maruts, worthy of sacrifice
- यत् (*yat*)—if perchance
- वः (*vaḥ*)—in regard to you
- आगः (*āgaḥ*)—sin
- पुरुषता (*puruṣatā*)—through human nature
- कराम (*karāma*)—we have committed
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- तस्यां (*tasyāṃ*)—to the weapon
- अपि (*api*)—even slightly
- मा भूम (*mā bhūma*)—do not make us subject
- चनिष्ठा (*caniṣṭhā*)—abounding in food
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- सुमतिः (*sumatiḥ*)—favouring mind
- अस्मे (*asme*)—upon us
- अस्तु (*astu*)—be

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, may that well-known weapon of yours be far from us. O Maruts, worthy of sacrifice, if through human nature we have committed sin in regard to you, do not make us subject to your weapon even slightly. May your favouring mind, rich in food, be upon us.

### Printed p. 372

##### English translation
May that blazing (weapon) of yours, Maruts, be far from us, although, through human infirmities, we offer you offence : let us not adorable Marute be exposed to your (shaft) : may your favour, the source of abundance, ever be shown unto us.

#### Ṛk 5

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> कृ॒ते चि॒दत्र॑ म॒रुतो॑ रणंतानव॒द्यासः॒ शुच॑यः पाव॒काः ।  
> प्र नो॑ऽवत सुम॒तिभि॑र्यजत्राः॒ प्र वाजे॑भिस्तिरत पु॒ष्यसे॑ नः ॥ ५ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> कृते । चित् । अत्र । मरुतः । रणंत । अनवद्यासः । शुचयः । पावकाः ।  
> प्र । नः । अवत । सुमतिभिः । यजत्राः । प्र । वाजेभिः । तिरत । पुष्यसे । नः ॥ ५ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> अत्रास्मिन्कृते चिदस्मदीये यज्ञकर्मण्येव मरुतो रणंत । रमंतां । ईदृशा मरुतः । अनवद्यासोऽनिंदिताः शुचयो दीप्तियुक्ताः पावकाः शोधका एवंभूता इति । किंच हे मरुतो यजत्रा यजनीयाः यूयं नोऽस्मान् सुमतिभिरनुग्रहबुद्धिभिः सुष्टुतिभिर्वा प्रावत । प्रकर्षेण पालयत । तथा नोऽस्मान् वाजेभिर्वाजैरन्नैः पुष्यसे पोषार्थं प्र तिरत । प्रवर्धयत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

May the Maruts delight (रणंत (*raṇaṃta*)) in this sacrificial rite of ours alone. Such are the Maruts: blameless, bright, purifying. Further, O adorable Maruts, protect us with favouring minds or with good praises (सुमतिभिः (*sumatibhiḥ*)), protect us excellently; and make us grow with food (वाजेभिः (*vājebhiḥ*)) for nourishment (पुष्यसे (*puṣyase*)).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अनवद्यासः (*anavadyāsaḥ*)—faultless
- शुचयः (*śucayaḥ*)—radiant
- पावकाः (*pāvakāḥ*)—purifying
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—the Maruts
- अत्र कृते चित् (*atra kṛte cit*)—in this sacrifice of ours alone
- रणंत (*raṇaṃta*)—let them find delight
- (O Maruts)
- यजत्राः (*yajatrāḥ*)—you, revered ones
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- सुमतिभिः (*sumatibhiḥ*)—with favouring minds
- प्र अवत (*pra avata*)—protect exceedingly
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- वाजेभिः (*vājebhiḥ*)—with foods
- पुष्यसे (*puṣyase*)—for a well-nourished life
- प्र तिरत (*pra tirata*)—make to grow

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May the Maruts, faultless, radiant and purifying, find delight in this sacrifice of ours alone. O Maruts, revered ones, protect us with favouring minds. Make us grow with foods for a well-nourished life.

### Printed p. 373

##### English translation
May the Maruts, who are irreproachable, pure, and purifying, delight in this our ceremony : protect us, adorable Maruts, with favourable thoughts : be ever anxious to sustain us with food.

#### Ṛk 6

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> उ॒त स्तु॒तासो॑ म॒रुतो॑ व्यंतु॒ विश्वे॑भि॒र्नाम॑भि॒र्नरो॑ ह॒वींषि॑  
> ददा॑त नो अ॒मृत॑स्य प्र॒जायै॑ जिगृ॒त रा॒यः सू॒नृता॑ म॒घानि॑ ॥ ६ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> उत । स्तुतासः । मरुतः । व्यंतु । विश्वेभिः । नामभिः । नरः । हवींषि ।  
> ददात । नः । अमृतस्य । प्रजायै । जिगृत । रायः । सूनृता । मघानि ॥ ६ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> उतापि च स्तुतास एवमस्माभिः स्तुता मरुतो हवींषि व्यंतु । भक्षयंतु कीदृशाः । विश्वेभिर्विश्वैर्नामभिरुदकैः सहिता नरो नेतारः । शेषः प्रत्यक्षस्तुतः । हे मरुतः नोऽस्मदीयायै प्रजायै संततयेऽमृतस्यामृतमुदकं ददात दत्त । तथा हविषो दातुर्यजमानस्य सूनृता सूनृतानि सुष्ठु नृत्यंति शोभनयोग्यानि मघानि धनानि जिगृत । उद्दिरत । प्रयच्छतेत्यर्थः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The Maruts, thus praised by us, are to eat the oblations. They are described as the leaders (नरो (*naro*)), accompanied by all the waters (नामभिः (*nāmabhiḥ*) = *udakaiḥ*); the rest is a direct address. "O Maruts, give the immortal water, that is, the water, to our progeny, our offspring. Likewise rouse up and bestow on the sacrificer, the giver of the oblation, the good and fittingly dancing (सूनृता (*sūnṛtā*)) riches (मघानि (*maghāni*))." जिगृत (*jigṛta*) means "rouse up", that is, "give".

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- विश्वेभिः (*viśvebhiḥ*)—all
- नामभिः (*nāmabhiḥ*)—with waters
- नरः (*naraḥ*)—leaders
- उत (*uta*)—and
- स्तुतासः (*stutāsaḥ*)—praised by us
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—Maruts
- हवींषि (*havīṃṣi*)—our oblations
- व्यंतु (*vyaṃtu*)—let them eat
- (O Maruts,) नः (*naḥ*)—our
- प्रजायै (*prajāyai*)—for progeny
- अमृतस्य (*amṛtasya*)—water
- ददात (*dadāta*)—give
- सूनृता (*sūnṛtā*)—auspicious and excellent
- मघानि (*maghāni*)—riches
- जिगृत (*jigṛta*)—provide

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May the Maruts, who are accompanied by all the waters, who are leaders and are praised by us, eat our oblation. O Maruts, provide water for our progeny. Give us auspicious and excellent riches.

### Printed p. 374

##### English translation

#### Ṛk 7

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> आ स्तु॒तासो॑ मरुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती अच्छा॑ सू॒रीन्स॒र्वता॑ता जिगात ।  
> ये न॒स्त्मना॑ श॒तिनो॑ व॒र्धयं॑ति यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ॥ ७ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> आ । स्तुतासः । मरुतः । विश्वे । ऊती । अच्छ । सूरीन् । सर्वताता । जिगात ।  
> ये । नः । त्मना । शतिनः । वर्धयंति । यूयं । पात । स्वस्तिभिः । सदा । नः ॥ ७ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः स्तुतास एवमस्माभिः स्तुता विश्वे सर्वे यूयमूत्यूत्या रक्षया सहिताः सूरीन् स्तोतॄनच्छाभिलक्ष्य सर्वताता सर्वतातौ यज्ञे आ जिगात । आगच्छत । ये मरुतस्त्मनैव नोऽस्मान् शतिनः शतसंख्याकान् वर्धयंति । यथा वयं पुत्रपौत्रादिभिः शतिनो भवेम । तथा वर्धयंतीत्यर्थः । ते यूयमा जिगातेति पूर्वेण संबंधः । एवंभूता मरुतः यूयं सर्वदास्मान् पालयत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, thus praised by us, all of you, together with your protection (ऊती (*ūtī*)), come to the sacrifice (सर्वताता (*sarvatātā*)) facing the praisers (सूरीन् (*sūrīn*)). The Maruts who of their own accord (त्मना (*tmanā*)) make us "possessed of hundreds" (शतिनः (*śatinaḥ*)) grow, that is, make us grow so that we become possessed of hundreds through sons, grandsons and the rest: you, such Maruts, are connected with the preceding आ जिगात (*ā jigāta*) ("come"). Such as you are, protect us always.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- ये (*ye*)—you who
- त्मना (*tmanā*)—of your own impulse
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- शतिनः (*śatinaḥ*)—exceedingly
- वर्धयंति (*vardhayaṃti*)—cause to prosper, such ones
- स्तुतासः (*stutāsaḥ*)—praised by us
- विश्वे (*viśve*)—all of you
- ऊती (*ūtī*)—with your protections
- सूरीन् अच्छ (*sūrīn accha*)—facing us, the praisers
- सर्वताता (*sarvatātā*)—at this sacrifice
- आ जिगात (*ā jigāta*)—come
- यूयं (*yūyaṃ*)—you
- नः (*naḥ*)—us
- सदा (*sadā*)—always
- स्वस्तिभिः (*svastibhiḥ*)—with blessings
- पात (*pāta*)—protect

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, you who of your own impulse make us prosper exceedingly, such ones, praised by us, all of you, come with your protections to this sacrifice facing us, the praisers. Protect us always with blessings.

### Printed p. 375

##### English translation
Glorified Maruts, do you all come at the time of sacrifice to the presence of the worshippers along with your protections, for you are they who, of your own will, multiply our hundreds : do you ever cherish us with blessings.

## Sūkta 58 (Maṇḍala 7)

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> प्र साकमुक्षे इति षडृचं तृतीयं सूक्तं वसिष्ठस्यार्षं त्रैष्टुभं मरुद्देवताकं । अनुक्रांतं च । प्र साकमुक्षे षडिति ॥ गतो विनियोगः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The sūkta प्र साकमुक्षे (*pra sākamukṣe*) is a hymn of six Ṛks, the third sūkta, of Vasiṣṭha as seer, in the Triṣṭubh metre, with the Maruts as deity. The Anukramaṇī says: प्र साकमुक्षे षडिति (*pra sākamukṣe ṣaḍiti*). The viniyoga has already been stated.

##### Anuvāda

This sūkta प्र साकमुक्षे (*pra sākamukṣe*) is the third sūkta in the fourth anuvāka. It has six Ṛks. Vasiṣṭha is the seer of this sūkta, the Maruts are the deity; the metre is Triṣṭubh. In the Anukramaṇī it is said प्र साकमुक्षे षट् (*pra sākamukṣe ṣaṭ*). The viniyoga has been stated before.

Sūkta—58
Maṇḍala—7; Anuvāka—3; Sūkta—58
Aṣṭaka—5; Adhyāya—4; Varga—28
Ṛks in the sūkta—6
Ṛṣi—Vasiṣṭha
Devatā—Maruts
Chandas—Triṣṭubh

#### Ṛk 1

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> प्र सा॑क॒मुक्षे॑ अर्चता ग॒णाय॒ यो दैव्य॑स्य॒ धाम्न॒स्तुवि॑ष्मान् ।  
> उ॒त क्षो॑दंति॒ रोद॑सी महि॒त्वा नक्षं॑ते॒ नाकं॒ निर्ऋ॑तेरवं॒शात् ॥ १ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> प्र । साकंउक्षे । अर्चत । गणाय । यः । दैव्यस्य । धाम्नः । तुविष्मान् ।  
> उत । क्षोदंति । रोदसी इति । महित्वा । नक्षंते । नाकं । निःऋतेः । अवंशात् ॥ १ ॥

### Printed p. 376

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे स्तोतारः यूयं साकमुक्षे सततं वर्षित्रे गणाय मरुत्समूहाय प्रार्चत । स्तोत्रं प्रोच्चारयत । यो मरुद्गणो दैव्यस्य देवसंबंधिनो धाम्नः स्वर्गाख्यस्य स्थानस्य तुविष्मान् वृद्धिमान्भवति । सर्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः प्रवृद्ध इत्यर्थः । तस्मै गणायेति पूर्वेण संबंधः । उतापि च मरुतो महित्वा स्वकीयेन महत्त्वेन सहिता रोदसी द्यावापृथिव्यौ क्षोदंति । भंजंति । तथा निर्ऋतेर्भूमेरवंशादंतरिक्षाच्च नाकं स्वर्गं नक्षंते । व्याप्नुवंति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O praisers, raise your praise to the group of the Maruts, the one that rains together and continuously (साकमुक्षे (*sākamukṣe*)). That Maruts' troop is strong (तुविष्मान् (*tuviṣmān*)), that is, grown mighty, over the divine abode (धाम्नः (*dhāmnaḥ*)), the place called heaven; it is pre-eminent over all gods. The word गणाय (*gaṇāya*) ("to the troop") is connected with the preceding. Moreover the Maruts with their own greatness (महित्वा (*mahitvā*)) break (क्षोदंति (*kṣodaṃti*)) the two worlds (रोदसी (*rodasī*)), heaven and earth. Likewise they pervade (नक्षंते (*nakṣaṃte*)) heaven (नाकं (*nākaṃ*)), from the earth (निर्ऋतेः (*nirṛteḥ*)) and through the firmament (अवंशात् (*avaṃśāt*)).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- (O praisers,) यः (*yaḥ*)—the Maruts' troop which
- दैव्यस्य (*daivyasya*)—of the divine
- धाम्नः (*dhāmnaḥ*)—abode, throughout the place of heaven
- तुविष्मान् (*tuviṣmān*)—is exceedingly strong, such a one
- साकमुक्षे (*sākamukṣe*)—and rains continuously
- गणाय (*gaṇāya*)—to that troop of Maruts
- प्रार्चत (*prārcata*)—offer praise
- उत (*uta*)—and
- (मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—the Maruts)
- महित्वा (*mahitvā*)—by their greatness
- रोदसी (*rodasī*)—heaven and earth
- क्षोदंति (*kṣodaṃti*)—they diminish
- निर्ऋतेः (*nirṛteḥ*)—starting from the earth
- अवंशात् (*avaṃśāt*)—through the firmament
- नाकं (*nākaṃ*)—all of heaven
- नक्षंते (*nakṣaṃte*)—they pervade

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O praisers, offer praise to the troop of Maruts which is exceedingly strong throughout the heavenly abode where the gods dwell and which rains continuously. The Maruts by their greatness diminish heaven and earth. Starting from the earth, through the firmament, they pervade all of heaven.

##### English translation
Offer worship to the company (of the Maruts), the associated dispensers of moisture, which is powerful over the celestial region : the Maruts, by their greatness, oppress both heaven and earth : they spread from the earth and the firmament to heaven,

#### Ṛk 2

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> ज॒नूश्चि॑द्वो मरुतस्त्वे॒ष्ये॑ण॒ भीमा॑स॒स्तुवि॑मन्य॒वोया॑सः ।  
> प्र ये महो॑भि॒रोज॑सो॒त संति॒ विश्वो॑ वो॒ याम॑न्भयते स्व॒र्दृक् ॥ २ ॥

### Printed p. 377

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> जनूः । चित् । वः । मरुतः । त्वेष्येण । भीमासः । तुविःमन्यवः । अयासः ।  
> प्र । ये । महःभिः । ओजसा । उत । संति । विश्वः । वः । यामन् । भयते । स्वःदृक् ॥ २ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे भीमासो भीमास्तुविमन्यवः प्रवृद्धमतयोऽयासो गंतार इति त्रीणि संबोधनानि । एवंभूता हे मरुतः वो युष्माकं जनूर्जन्म त्वेष्येण दीप्तेन रुद्रेण बभूवेति शेषः । उतापि च ये मरुतो महोभिस्तेजोभिरोजसा बलेन च प्र संति प्रभवंति तेषां वो युष्माकं यामन् यामनि गमने विश्वः स्वर्दृक् सूर्यस्य द्रष्टा सर्वो जीवसमूहः । यद्वा । स्वरंतरिक्षं । तत्पश्यतीति वृक्षः स्वर्दृक् । सर्वोऽस्मादित्यर्थः भयते । बिभेति ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

"Formidable (भीमासः (*bhīmāsaḥ*)), of mighty mind (तुविमन्यवः (*tuvimanyavaḥ*)), swift-going (अयासः (*ayāsaḥ*))": these are three vocatives. O Maruts, such as you are, your birth (जनूः (*janūḥ*)) came about from the bright (त्वेष्येण (*tveṣyeṇa*)) Rudra; "came about" is the supplied remainder. Moreover, of you Maruts who are pre-eminent (प्र संति (*pra saṃti*)) in splendours (महोभिः (*mahobhiḥ*)) and in strength (ओजसा (*ojasā*)), at your going (यामन् (*yāman*)) every स्वर्दृक् (*svardṛk*), that is, the whole host of living beings that sees the sun, is afraid (भयते (*bhayate*)). Or else: स्वः (*svaḥ*) is the firmament; what sees it is a tree, स्वर्दृक् (*svardṛk*); everything is afraid of this.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- भीमासः (*bhīmāsaḥ*)—terrible
- तुविमन्यवः (*tuvimanyavaḥ*)—of exceeding mind
- अयासः (*ayāsaḥ*)—swift-going
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- जनूः (*janūḥ*)—birth
- त्वेष्येण (*tveṣyeṇa*)—has come about from the radiant Rudra
- उत (*uta*)—and
- ये (*ye*)—you who
- महोभिः (*mahobhiḥ*)—with your splendours
- ओजसा (*ojasā*)—and with strength
- प्र संति (*pra saṃti*)—are mighty, such ones
- वः (*vaḥ*)—your
- यामन् (*yāman*)—at the time of going
- स्वर्दृक् (*svardṛk*)—(like a tree) looking at the firmament
- विश्वः (*viśvaḥ*)—all people
- भयते (*bhayate*)—are afraid

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, terrible, of exceeding mind and swift-going, your birth has come about from the radiant Rudra. At the time of your going, when you are mighty with your splendours and strength, all people (or trees), looking at the firmament, are afraid.

##### English translation
Formidable, high-spirited, quick-moving Maruts, your birth is from the illustrious Rudra : every gazer on the sun is alarmed with the course of you who are pre-eminent in lusture and strength.

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> बृ॒हद्वयो॑ म॒घव॑द्भ्यो दधात॒ जुजो॑ष॒न्निन्म॒रुतः॑ सुष्टु॒तिं नः॑

### Printed p. 378

> गतो नाध्वा वि तिराति जंतुं प्र नः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेत ॥ ३ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> बृहत् । वयः । मघवत्भ्यः । दधात । जुजोषन् । इत् । मरुतः । सुस्तुतिं । नः ।  
> गतः । न । अध्वा । वि । तिराति । जंतुं । प्र । नः । स्पार्हाभिः । ऊतिभिः । तिरेत ॥ ३ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः यूयं मघवद्भ्यो हविर्लक्षणान्नवद्भ्योऽस्मभ्यं बृहन्महद्वयोऽन्नं दधात । प्रयच्छत । नोऽस्मदीयां सुष्टुतिं शोभनं स्तोत्रं जुजोषन्नित् । सेवंतामेव । गतो मरुद्भिः प्राप्तोऽध्वा मार्गो जंतुं प्राणिनं न वि तिराति । नाहंति । उदकेनाप्याययत्येव । यद्वा । वितिरतिर्वर्धनार्थः । नेति चार्थे । मरुद्भिर्गतो मार्गश्च जंतुं वर्धयति । तथा नोऽस्मान् स्पार्हाभिः स्पृहणीयाभिरूतिभी रक्षाभिः प्र तिरेत । प्रवर्धयंते ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, give (दधात (*dadhāta*)) to us, who have oblation-wealth (मघवद्भ्यः (*maghavadbhyaḥ*)), great food (बृहत् वयः (*bṛhat vayaḥ*)). Let them indeed accept (जुजोषन् इत् (*jujoṣan it*)) our good praise. The path (अध्वा (*adhvā*)) travelled (गतः (*gataḥ*)) by the Maruts does not harm (न वि तिराति (*na vi tirāti*)) a living being (जंतुं (*jaṃtuṃ*)); it refreshes with water. Or else: the root वितिर (*vitira*) has the sense of increasing, and न (*na*) is in the sense of "and": the path travelled by the Maruts makes the creature grow. Likewise they cause us to prosper (प्र तिरेत (*pra tireta*)) with desirable (स्पार्हाभिः (*spārhābhiḥ*)) protections (ऊतिभिः (*ūtibhiḥ*)).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- मघवद्भ्यः (*maghavadbhyaḥ*)—to us who have oblations
- बृहत् (*bṛhat*)—abundant
- वयः (*vayaḥ*)—food
- दधात (*dadhāta*)—give
- नः (*naḥ*)—our
- सुष्टुतिं (*suṣṭutiṃ*)—excellent praise
- जुजोषन् इत् (*jujoṣan it*)—surely accept
- गतः (*gataḥ*)—taken refuge in by the Maruts
- अध्वा (*adhvā*)—path
- जंतुं (*jaṃtuṃ*)—the host of creatures
- न वि तिराति (*na vi tirāti*)—does not harm
- (they) नः (*naḥ*)—us
- स्पार्हाभिः (*spārhābhiḥ*)—with desired
- ऊतिभिः (*ūtibhiḥ*)—protections
- प्र तिरेत (*pra tireta*)—cause to prosper

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, give abundant food to us who offer oblations. Surely accept our excellent praise. The path that the Maruts follow does not harm the host of creatures. They make us prosper with desired protections.

##### English translation
Grant, Maruts, to us who are affluent (in sacrificial offering) abundant food : accept complacently our earnest praise : the path you follow is not hurtful to living beings : may it increase our (prosperity) by (your) desirable protections.

> देष्णं ॥ ४ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः युष्मोतो युष्माभी रक्षितो विप्रः स्तोता शतस्वी शतसंख्योपेतधनवान्भवति । युष्मोतो युष्माभी रक्षितोऽर्वाभिगंता सहुरिः शत्रूणामभिभविता स्तोता सहस्री सहस्रधनवान्भवति । युष्मोतो युष्माभी रक्षितः सम्राट् साम्राज्ययुक्तो भवति । उतापि च वृत्रं शत्रुं हंति । युष्मद्रक्षको हिनस्ति । हे धूतयः कंपयितारो मरुतः वो युष्माभिर्दत्तं तत्प्रसिद्धं देष्णं धनं प्रास्तु । प्रभूतं भवतु ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, the singer (vipra) protected by you becomes possessed of hundreds in wealth. The one protected by you who is an assailant (arvā) and overcomer of enemies (sahuri), a singer, becomes possessed of thousands in wealth. One protected by you becomes an emperor, and he also slays the foe (vṛtra); the one who has you as protector destroys. O Shakers (dhūtayaḥ), Maruts, may that well-known wealth (deṣṇa) given by you be abundant, may it be plentiful.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- युष्मोतः (*yuṣmotaḥ*)—protected by you
- विप्रः (*vipraḥ*)—the praiser
- शतस्वी (*śatasvī*)—becomes a possessor of wealth in the hundreds
- युष्मोतः (*yuṣmotaḥ*)—protected by you
- अर्वा (*arvā*)—your worshipper
- सहुरिः (*sahuriḥ*)—becomes a vanquisher of enemies
- सहस्री (*sahasrī*)—also becomes a possessor of wealth in the thousands
- युष्मोतः (*yuṣmotaḥ*)—protected by you
- सम्राट् (*samrāṭ*)—becomes a universal sovereign
- उत (*uta*)—and
- वृत्रं (*vṛtraṃ*)—the enemy
- हंति (*haṃti*)—kills
- धूतयः (*dhūtayaḥ*)—O Maruts, who make everything tremble
- वः (*vaḥ*)—given by you
- तत् (*tat*)—that famous
- देष्णं (*deṣṇaṃ*)—wealth
- प्र अस्तु (*pra astu*)—may it grow abundantly

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, the praiser protected by you becomes a possessor of wealth in hundreds and in thousands. With the help of your protection, your worshipper defeats his enemies.

### Printed p. 380
Such a sacrificer becomes a universal sovereign. O Maruts, who have the power to set everything in motion, may the excellent wealth given by you increase abundantly among us.

##### English translation
The pious man protected, Maruts, by you, is the possessor of hundreds; the assailant, overcomer (of his foes), protected by you, is the possessor of thousands: protected by you, the Emperor slays his enemy: may the wealth that is given, agitators, by you ever be abundant.

#### Ṛk 5

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> तान् आ रु॒द्रस्य॑ मा॒ळ्हुषो॑ विवासे कु॒विन्नंसं॑ते म॒रुतः॒ पुन॑र्नः ।  
> यत्स॒स्वर्ता॑ जिहीळि॒रे यदा॒विरव॒ तदेन॑ ईमहे तु॒राणां॑ ॥५॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> तान् । आ । रुद्रस्य । माळ्हुषः । विवासे । कुवित् । नंसंते । मरुतः । पुनः । नः ।  
> यत् । सस्वर्ता । जिहीळिरे । यत् । आविः । अव । तत् । एनः । ईमहे । तुराणां ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> माळ्हुषः कामानां वर्षितो रुद्रस्येश्वरस्य पुत्रांस्तान्मरुत आ विवासे ।
> अहं होता परिचरामि । ते मरुतो नोऽस्मभ्यं कुविद्बहुकृत्वः पुनर्भूयो
> नंसंते । नमंतां । अभिमुखीभवंतु । कुविच्छब्देनैव पुनःकार्थस्य लब्धत्वात्पुनः शब्दग्रहणं किमर्थं । आदरार्थं । सस्वर्तांतर्हितेनाप्रकाशेन यद्येनैनसा
> जिहीळिरे मरुतः क्रुध्येयुः आविः प्रकाशेन यद्येनैनसा च जिहीळिरे तुराणां
> त्वराणां मरुतां संबंधि तदुभयमेनोऽपराधमवेमहे । स्तोत्रेण पयमपनयामः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

I, the hotṛ, serve those Maruts, sons of Rudra, the lord, the showerer of desires. May those Maruts bow to us again and many times, that is, turn towards us. Since the word कुवित् (*kuvit*) itself already gives the sense of "again", why is the word पुनः (*punaḥ*) taken? For emphasis. Whatever offence, hidden (the word सस्वर्ता (*sasvartā*) meaning "concealed"), or open, has angered the Maruts: both that offence, committed in regard to the swift Maruts, we remove by praise, and thereby we turn away their anger.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- माळ्हुषः (*māḷhuṣaḥ*)—of the giver of desired objects
- रुद्रस्य (*rudrasya*)—of Rudra, whose sons they are
- तान् (*tān*)—those Maruts
- आ विवासे (*ā vivāse*)—I worship and honour
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—the Maruts
- पुनः कुवित् (*punaḥ kuvit*)—(again and again) many times
- नः (*naḥ*)—towards us
- नंसंते (*naṃsaṃte*)—may they come bowing, facing us
- सस्वर्ता (*sasvartā*)—concealed, not manifest
- यत् (*yat*)—by which sin
- जिहीळिरे (*jihīḷire*)—the Maruts may be angered
- आविः (*āviḥ*)—manifest
- यत् (*yat*)—by which sin they become angry

### Printed p. 381
- तुराणां (*turāṇāṃ*)—swift-moving; of those Maruts, committed in regard to them
- तत् (*tat*)—that twofold
- एनः (*enaḥ*)—sin
- अव-ईमहे (*ava-īmahe*)—we remove

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

I worship and honour the Maruts, sons of Rudra, the giver of desired objects. May those same Maruts favour us and come many times. Of the two kinds of sin (inner and outer), the one not manifest outwardly and the one manifest, by which the Maruts become incensed, those two kinds of sin committed in regard to them we remove.

##### English translation
I adore those sons of the showerer, Rudra : may the Maruts, repeatedly invoked, again come to us : may we expiate (by praise) whatever we have committed secretly or openly against the swift-moving Maruts, by which they are displeased.

##### विशेषविषयगळु (Special Topics)

नंसंते (*naṃsaṃte*)—Yāska, giving the etymology of this word, says: कुविन्नंसंते मरुतः पुनर्नः (*kuvinnaṃsaṃte marutaḥ punarnaḥ*) (Ni. 4-13), पुनर्नो नमंते मरुतः (*punarno namaṃte marutaḥ*); that is, the Marut deities will bow and come towards us again and again. He has explained the word नंसंते (*naṃsaṃte*) as नमंते (*namaṃte*), "they bow".

#### Ṛk 6

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> प्र सा वा॑चि सुष्टु॒तिर्म॒घोना॑मि॒दं सू॒क्तं म॒रुतो॑ जुषंत  
> आ॒राच्चि॒द्द्वेषो॑ वृषणो युयोत यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ ॑ 
> सदा नः ॥ ६ ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> प्र । सा । वाचि । सुस्तुतिः । मघोनां । इदं । सुऽउक्तं । मरुतः । जुषंत ।  
> आरात् । चित् । द्वेषः । वृषणः । युयोत । यूयं । पात । स्वस्तिभिः । सदा । नः ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> मघोनां धनवतां मरुतां संबंधिनी सुष्टुतिर्या शोभना स्तुतिरस्मिन्सूक्ते कृता सा स्तुतिरस्माभिः प्र वाचि । प्रोक्तासीत् । मरुत इदमादृग्भूतं सूक्तं जुषंत । सेवंतां । हे वृषणः कामानां वर्षितारः यूयं द्वेषो द्वेषांसि शत्रूनाराच्चिद्दूरादेव युयोत । अस्मत्तः पृथक्कुरुत । यूयं नोऽस्मान् स्वस्तिभिः सर्वदा रक्षत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The good praise (suṣṭuti) of the wealthy Maruts, the beautiful praise made in this hymn, has been recited by us. May the Maruts enjoy this hymn of such a kind. O showerers of desires, remove far away the haters, the enemies. Protect us always with blessings.

- मघोनां (*maghonāṃ*)—for the wealthy Maruts

The hymn that has been composed addressing the wealthy Maruts has been recited by us. May the Maruts enjoy this hymn. O Maruts, givers of desired objects, separate our enemies from us at a distance. O Maruts, protect us always with blessings.

## Sūkta 59 (Maṇḍala 7)

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> यं त्रायध्व इति द्वादशर्चं चतुर्थं सूक्तं । अत्रेयमनुक्रमणिका ।
> यं त्रायध्वे द्वादश त्रिष्टुब्गाथादि नवम्याद्यास्तिस्रो गायत्र्योऽंत्यानुष्टुब्रौद्री
> मृत्युविमोचिनीति । आद्यातृतीयापंचम्यो बृहत्यो द्वितीयाचतुर्थीषष्ठ्यः सतोबृहत्यः सप्तम्यष्टम्यावनुक्तौ त्रिष्टुभौ नवमादशम्येकादश्यो गायत्र्यः ।
> द्वादश्यनुष्टुप् सा च रुद्रदेवताका । शिष्टा मारुत्यः ॥ सूक्तविनियोगो लैंगिकः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The sūkta यं त्रायध्वे (*yaṃ trāyadhve*) has twelve Ṛks and is the fourth sūkta. The Anukramaṇikā says: यं त्रायध्वे द्वादश त्रिष्टुब्गाथादि नवम्याद्यास्तिस्रो गायत्र्योऽंत्यानुष्टुब्रौद्री मृत्युविमोचिनी (*yaṃ trāyadhve dvādaśa triṣṭubgāthādi navamyādyāstisro gāyatryo 'ṃtyānuṣṭubraudrī mṛtyuvimocinī*). The first, third and fifth Ṛks are Bṛhatī; the second, fourth and sixth are Satobṛhatī; the seventh and eighth are two Triṣṭubhs, not otherwise specified; the ninth, tenth and eleventh are Gāyatrī; the twelfth is Anuṣṭubh and has Rudra as deity. The rest are addressed to the Maruts. The use of the sūkta is of the Laiṅgika kind (determined by the indicative character of the text).

##### Anuvāda

This sūkta यं त्रायध्वे (*yaṃ trāyadhve*) is the fourth sūkta in the fourth anuvāka. It contains twelve Ṛks. In the Anukramaṇikā it is said: यं त्रायध्वे द्वादश त्रिष्टुब्गाथादि नवम्याद्यास्तिस्रो गायत्र्योऽंत्यानुष्टुब्रौद्री मृत्युविमोचिनी (*yaṃ trāyadhve dvādaśa triṣṭubgāthādi navamyādyāstisro gāyatryo 'ṃtyānuṣṭubraudrī mṛtyuvimocinī*). The first and fifth Ṛks of this sūkta are in the Bṛhatī metre. The second, fourth and sixth Ṛks are in the Satobṛhatī metre. The seventh and eighth Ṛks are in the Triṣṭubh metre.

### Printed p. 383
The ninth, tenth and eleventh Ṛks are in the Gāyatrī metre. The twelfth Ṛk is in the Anuṣṭubh metre and has Rudra as its deity. The remaining Ṛks have the Maruts as deity. The use of the sūkta is Laiṅgika.

Sūkta—59
Maṇḍala—7. Anuvāka—4. Sūkta—59.
Aṣṭaka—5. Adhyāya—4. Varga—29, 30.
Number of Ṛks in the sūkta—12.
Ṛṣi: Vasiṣṭha.
Deity: 1–11 the Maruts; 12 Rudra (the Ṛk that frees from death).
Metre: 1, 3, 5 Bṛhatī; 2, 4, 6 Satobṛhatī; 7, 8 Triṣṭubh; 9–11 Gāyatrī; 12 Anuṣṭubh.

#### Ṛk 1

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यं त्राय॑ध्व इ॒दमि॑दं॒ देवा॑सो॒ यं च॒ नय॑थ ।  
> तस्मा॑ अग्ने॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्रार्य॑म॒न्मरु॑तः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छत ॥१॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यं । त्रायध्वे । इदंइदं । देवासः । यं । च । नयथ ।  
> तस्मै । अग्ने । वरुण । मित्र । अर्यमन् । मरुतः । शर्म । यच्छत ॥१॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे देवासो देवाः इदमिदमितो भयहेतोर्यं स्तोतारं त्रायध्वे पालयध्वे । यं च स्तोतारं नयथ सन्मार्गं प्रापयथ । हे अग्ने वरुण मित्रा
> र्यमन् हे मरुत एवंभूता हे देवाः तस्मै स्तोत्रे शर्म सुखं यच्छत ।
> दत्त ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O gods, whichever singer you protect from every cause of fear, and whomever you lead along the good path: O Agni, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Maruts, such gods, grant happiness to that singer.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- अग्ने (*agne*)—O Agni
- वरुण (*varuṇa*)—O Varuṇa
- मित्र (*mitra*)—O Mitra
- अर्यमन् (*aryaman*)—O Aryaman
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- देवासः (*devāsaḥ*)—O all gods
- इदमिदं (*idamidaṃ*)—from every cause of fear
- यं (*yaṃ*)—whichever singer
- त्रायध्वे (*trāyadhve*)—you protect
- यं च (*yaṃ ca*)—and whomever
- नयथ (*nayatha*)—you lead on the good path
- तस्मै (*tasmai*)—to such a singer
- शर्म (*śarma*)—happiness
- यच्छत (*yacchata*)—provide

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Agni, O Varuṇa, O Aryaman, O Maruts, O all gods, whichever singer you protect from every cause of fear and lead along the good path, to such a singer provide happiness.

### Printed p. 384

##### English translation
Agni, Varuna, Mitra, Maruts, grant happiness, gods, to him whom you preserve from (the perils of) this (world), whom you guide here (to the paths of virtue).

#### Ṛk 2

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यु॒ष्माकं॑ देवा॒ अव॒साह॑नि प्रि॒ये ई॑जा॒नस्त॑रति॒ द्विषः॑ ।  
> प्र स क्षयं॑ तिरते॒ वि म॒हीरिषो॒ यो वो॒ वरा॑य॒ दाश॑ति ॥२॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> युष्माकं । देवाः । अवसा । अहनि । प्रिये । ईजानः । तरति । द्विषः ।  
> प्र । सः । क्षयं । तिरते । वि । महीः । इषः । यः । वः । वराय । दाशति ॥२॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे देवाः युष्माकं युष्मदीयेनावसा रक्षणेन प्रियेऽहनि सर्वेषां
> देवानां प्रियभूते सुत्याभिधाने दिवस ईजान इष्टवान्यजमानो द्विषः शत्रूंस्तरति ।
> आक्रामति । स यजमानः क्षयं स्वकीयं निवासं प्र तिरते । प्रवर्धयति । यो
> यजमानो वो युष्मभ्यं महीर्महांतीषो हविर्लक्षणान्यन्नानि वराय निवारणाय यूयं नान्यत्र गच्छतास्मदीयान्येव हवींषि स्वीकुरुतेति निरोधनं कर्तुं
> वि दाशति विशेषेण प्रददाति । अत एव स स्वकीयं निवासं वर्धयतीत्यर्थः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O gods, by your protection, on the day dear to all gods, the day named for the pressing (of soma), the sacrificer who has sacrificed overcomes his enemies; he assails them. That sacrificer promotes his own dwelling. The sacrificer who gives to you great offerings, in the form of oblations, with a special giving, in order to prevent (वराय (*varāya*)) your going elsewhere, saying "do not go elsewhere, accept only our oblations", thereby makes his own dwelling grow; this is the meaning.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- देवाः (*devāḥ*)—O gods
- युष्माकं (*yuṣmākaṃ*)—your
- अवसा (*avasā*)—together with protection
- प्रिये अहनि (*priye ahani*)—on the days of sacrifice dear to you
- ईजानः (*ījānaḥ*)—the sacrificer who worships you
- द्विषः (*dviṣaḥ*)—enemies
- तरति (*tarati*)—conquers
- यः (*yaḥ*)—the sacrificer who
- वः (*vaḥ*)—to you
- महीः (*mahīḥ*)—very abundant
- इषः (*iṣaḥ*)—oblations
- वराय (*varāya*)—in order to prevent your going to another sacrificer
- वि दाशति (*vi dāśati*)—offers specially
- सः (*saḥ*)—that same sacrificer
- क्षयं (*kṣayaṃ*)—his dwelling-place
- प्र तिरते (*pra tirate*)—causes to grow

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O gods, together with your protection, the sacrificer who worships you on the days of sacrifice dear to you conquers his enemies. The one who offers you very abundant oblations in order to prevent your going to another sacrificer, that same sacrificer makes his dwelling-place grow.

### Printed p. 385

##### English translation
Through your protection, gods, the man who worships on an auspicious day overcomes his adversaries: he who offers abundant (sacrificial) food to you to detain you (at his rite) enlarges his habitation.

#### Ṛk 3

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> न॒हि व॑श्चर॒मं च॒ न वसि॑ष्ठः परि॒मंस॑ते ।  
> अ॒स्माक॑म॒द्य म॑रुतः सु॒ते सचा॒ विश्वे॑ पिबत का॒मिनः॑ ॥३॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> नहि । वः । चरमं । चन । वसिष्ठः । परिंमंसते ।  
> अस्माकं । अद्य । मरुतः । सुते । सचा । विश्वे । पिबत । कामिनः ॥३॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> वसिष्ठ ऋषिर्वो युष्माकं मध्ये चरमं चनावरमपि नहि परिमंसते । वर्जयित्वा न स्तौति किंतु सर्वानेव युष्मान् स्तौतीत्यर्थः । अद्यास्मिन्दिनेऽस्माकमदीये सुते सोमेऽभिषुते सति हे मरुतः कामिनः सोमं कामयमाना विश्वे
> यूयं सचा संगत्य पिबत । पानं कुरुत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

The seer Vasiṣṭha does not slight even the last, the lowest, among you; he does not leave anyone out in his praise but praises all of you. Today, on this day, when our Soma has been pressed, O Maruts, all of you who desire Soma, come together and drink; that is, perform the drinking.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- कामिनः (*kāminaḥ*)—those desiring Soma
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- वः (*vaḥ*)—among you
- चरमं चन (*caramaṃ cana*)—even the very lowest
- वसिष्ठः (*vasiṣṭhaḥ*)—Vasiṣṭha
- नहि परिमंसते (*nahi parimaṃsate*)—does not despise
- अद्य (*adya*)—on this sacrificial day
- अस्माकं (*asmākaṃ*)—by us
- सुते (*sute*)—when the Soma is pressed and offered
- विश्वे (*viśve*)—all of you
- सचा (*sacā*)—gathered together
- पिबत (*pibata*)—drink the Soma

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, desirous of Soma, Vasiṣṭha does not despise even the very lowest among you. On this sacrificial day, when the Soma has been pressed and offered by us, all of you come together and drink the Soma.

##### English translation
Vasishtha overlooks not the very lowest amongst you, Maruts, who are desirous (of the libation), do you all drink together to-day of our effused Soma juices.

> खलु हिनस्ति । शत्रुभिः कृतां हिंसां न सहत इत्यर्थः । हे नरो नेतारो यूयं
> यस्मै जनायाराध्वं कामानदध्वं तं जनं न हिनस्तीति संबंधः । नवीयसी नवतरा वो युष्मदीया सुमतिरनुग्रहबुद्धिरभ्यावर्त् । अस्मानभ्यावर्ततां । तथा हे
> पिपीषवः सोमपानकामाः यूयमपि तूयं क्षिप्रं यात । आगच्छत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, your protection does not harm in battles; that is, it does not tolerate the harm done by enemies. O leaders, the person to whom you grant desires, him it does not harm. - वः (*vaḥ*)—your

- नवीयसी (*navīyasī*)—new

O leading Maruts, the sacrificer to whom you grant desired objects is not harmed by your protection in times of battle. May your new (excellent) benevolent thought turn toward us. You also, who desire to drink Soma, come toward us.

##### English translation
Your protection, leaders (of rites), yields no detriment to him whom you defend in battles: may your latest favour return to us: come quickly, eager to drink the Soma.

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, whose riches (राधांसि (*rādhāṃsi*)) are mutually rubbed together, i.e. well gathered: come well to the food, the Soma-oblations, for drinking, i.e. to consume them. Since I give you these oblations, therefore do not go elsewhere.

- हि (*hi*)—for which reason

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, who have accumulated wealth, for the sake of which I offer these oblations to you, for that reason come here to partake of these offered oblations. By no means go elsewhere.

##### English translation
Do you whose riches are connected together come to partake of the (sacrificial) viands, for, Maruts, I offer to you these oblations, therefore go not away to any other (sacrifice).

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> अस्रेधंतो मरुतः सोम्ये मधौ स्वाहेह मादयाध्वै ॥६॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> आ । च । नः । बर्हिः । सदत । अवित । च । नः । स्पार्हाणि । दातवे । वसु ।  
> अस्रेधंतः । मरुतः । सोम्ये । मधौ । स्वाहा । इह । मादयाध्वै ॥६॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> हे मरुतः यूयं नोऽस्मदीये बर्हिः कुशमये बर्हिष्या सदत च ।
> उपविशत । स्पार्हाणि स्पृहणीयानि वसु वसूनि धनानि दातवेऽस्मभ्यं दातुं नोऽस्मानवित च । आगच्छत च । हे मरुतः अस्रेधंतो हिंसंतो यूयमिहास्मिन्नज्ञे
> मधौ मदकरे सोम्ये सोमात्मके हविसि स्वाहा स्वाहाकारेण मादयाध्वै ।
> मादयध्वं । माद्यत ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

O Maruts, sit upon our sacred grass (बर्हिः (*barhiḥ*)), made of kuśa; sit down. Come to help us, to give us desirable riches. O Maruts, doing no harm, delight here in this sacrifice, with the cry of svāhā, in the intoxicating Soma-oblation; मादयाध्वै (*mādayādhvai*) means "delight".

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- (O Maruts) नः (*naḥ*)—our
- बर्हिः (*barhiḥ*)—on the seat of darbha grass
- आ सदत (*ā sadata*)—sit down
- स्पार्हाणि (*spārhāṇi*)—highly desired
- वसु (*vasu*)—riches
- दातवे (*dātave*)—to give
- नः (*naḥ*)—to us
- अवित च (*avita ca*)—come
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- अस्रेधंतः (*asredhaṃtaḥ*)—you who do no harm
- इह (*iha*)—in this our sacrifice
- स्वाहा (*svāhā*)—offered with the svāhā cry
- मधौ (*madhau*)—delight-giving
- सोम्ये (*somye*)—and consisting of Soma, in the oblation
- मादयाध्वै (*mādayādhvai*)—enjoy satisfaction

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, sit on our darbha seat. Come to us to give us the riches we greatly desire. O Maruts, you who are free from harming, in this our sacrifice enjoy the satisfaction that comes with the svāhā cry in the oblation that gives delight and consists of Soma.

##### English translation
Sit down on our sacred grass: come to bestow upon us desirable riches: doing no harm, Maruts, delight in the sweet Soma libation presented at this season.

#### Ṛk 7

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> स॒स्वश्चि॒द्धि त॒न्व१॒ः॑ शुंभ॑माना॒ आ हं॒सासो॒ नील॑पृष्ठा अपप्तन् ।

### Printed p. 389

> विश्वं शर्धो अभितो मा नि षेद नरो न रण्वाः सवने मदंतः ॥७॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> सस्वः । चित् । हि । तन्वः । शुंभमानाः । आ । हंसासः । नीलपृष्ठाः । अपप्तन् ।  
> विश्वं । शर्धः । अभितः । मा । नि । सेद । नरः । न । रण्वाः । सवने । मदंतः ॥७॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> सस्वरंतर्हिता मरुतस्तन्वः स्वकीयान्यंगानि शुंभमाना अलंकरणैः शोभयंतो मरुतो नीलपृष्ठा असितवर्णा हंसासो हंसा इवापप्तन् । आपतंतु ।
> आगच्छंतु । विश्वं शर्धो व्याप्तो मरुद्गणो वा मामभितः समंतान्नि षेद । निषीदतु । तत्र दृष्टांतः । सवनेऽस्मदीये यज्ञे मदंतो हृष्यंतो रण्वा रमणीया नरो न मनुष्या इव ऋत्विगादयो यथा निषीदंति तद्वत् ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

सस्वः (*sasvaḥ*) is a word with the svara concealed; it refers to the Maruts. Adorning their own bodies with ornaments, the dark-backed Maruts are to descend like swans; let them come. The whole, pervading company of Maruts is to sit down all around me. The illustration: as at our sacrifice, delighted and charming men such as the priests sit down, so may they.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- सस्वः (*sasvaḥ*)—Maruts of hidden form
- तन्वः (*tanvaḥ*)—their limbs
- शुंभमानाः (*śuṃbhamānāḥ*)—adorning
- नीलपृष्ठाः (*nīlapṛṣṭhāḥ*)—with dark-blue backs
- हंसासः (*haṃsāsaḥ*)—like swans
- आ अपप्तन् (*ā apaptan*)—may they descend
- सवने (*savane*)—at our sacrifice
- मदंतः (*madaṃtaḥ*)—who rejoice
- रण्वाः (*raṇvāḥ*)—and have attractive form
- नरो न (*naro na*)—like priests and the like
- विश्वं शर्धः (*viśvaṃ śardhaḥ*)—the entire company of Maruts
- मा अभितः (*mā abhitaḥ*)—around me
- नि षेद (*ni ṣeda*)—may it sit

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

May the Maruts, whose form is not revealed outwardly, adorn their limbs and descend like swans with blue-colored backs. May the whole company of Maruts also sit around me, like priests and the like who rejoice at our sacrifice and are of attractive form.

##### English translation
May the Maruts yet unrevealed, decorating their persons, descend like black-backed swans: let the entire company gather round me like happy men rejoicing together at a solemn rite.

#### Ṛk 8

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> यो नो॑ मरुतो अ॒भि दु॑र्हृणा॒युस्ति॒रश्चि॒त्तानि॑ वसवो॒ जिघां॑सति ।

### Printed p. 390

> द्रुहः पाशान्प्रति स मुचीष्ट तपिष्ठेन हन्मना हंतना तं ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> यः । नः । मरुतः । अभि । दुःहृणायुः । तिरः । चित्तानि । वसवः । जिघांसति ।  
> द्रुहः । पाशान् । प्रति । सः । मुचीष्ट । तपिष्ठेन । हन्मना । हंतन । तं ॥ ८ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> साकमेधेषु मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्य इत्यस्य यो नो मरुत इति पूर्वानुवाक्या सांतपना इदमिति याज्या । तथा च सूत्रितं । सांतपना इदं हविर्यो नो मरुतो अभिदुर्हृणायुः । आ. २-१८ । इति ॥
> हे वसवः प्रशस्या हे मरुतः नोऽस्मदीयानि चित्तानि दुर्हृणायुरशोभनं क्रुध्यंस्तिरः सर्वस्मिंस्तिरस्कृतो यो जनोऽभि जिघांसति अभिमुखेन हंतुमिच्छति स जनो द्रुहः पापानां द्रोग्धुर्वरुणस्य पाशानस्मासु प्रति स मुचीष्ट । बध्नीयात् । यूयं तं जनं तपिष्ठेन तप्तृतमेन हन्मना हननसाधनेनायुधेन हंतन । हत । हिंस्त ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

In the Sākamedha rites, for the Sāntapana Maruts, the verse यो नो मरुत (*yo no maruta*) is the puronuvākyā and सांतपना इदं (*sāṃtapanā idaṃ*) is the yājyā. So it is stated in the sūtra: सांतपना इदं हविर्यो नो मरुतो अभिदुर्हृणायुः (*sāṃtapanā idaṃ haviryo no maruto abhidurhṛṇāyuḥ*) (Ā. 2-18).
O Vasus, praiseworthy Maruts: the person who, angrily and ill-willed, scorned by all, wishes to kill us face to face, may he fasten on us the bonds of Varuṇa, the injurer of the wicked (द्रुहः (*druhaḥ*)); may he bind us. Do you slay that man with the most burning weapon, the instrument of killing.

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- वसवः (*vasavaḥ*)—O excellent
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—Maruts
- नः (*naḥ*)—our
- चित्तानि (*cittāni*)—minds
- दुर्हृणायुः (*durhṛṇāyuḥ*)—one who cruelly hurts
- यः (*yaḥ*)—whoever
- अभि जिघांसति (*abhi jighāṃsati*)—wishes to kill us
- सः (*saḥ*)—he
- द्रुहः (*druhaḥ*)—of Varuṇa, the injurer of sinners
- पाशान् (*pāśān*)—the bonds
- प्रति स मुचीष्ट (*prati sa mucīṣṭa*)—may let loose upon us
- तं (*taṃ*)—such a person
- तपिष्ठेन (*tapiṣṭhena*)—with a burning
- हन्मना (*hanmanā*)—with weapons
- हंतन (*haṃtana*)—kill

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O excellent Maruts, those who cruelly hurt our minds and wish to kill us may loose upon us the bonds of Varuṇa, the injurer of sinners. Kill such people with your burning weapons.

##### English translation
The man, Maruts, who wounds our feelings, he who rebuked by all, yet seeks, Vasus, to kill us, he would bind us in the bonds of (Varuna), the avenger (of iniquity), such a man do you destroy with a consuming fatal weapon.

### Printed p. 391

##### विशेषविषयगळु (Special Topics)

In the Sākamedha offerings made to the deities called Marudbhyaḥ Sāntapanebhyaḥ, this Ṛk beginning यो नो मरुतः (*yo no marutaḥ*) is to be recited as the Anuvākyā mantra, and the next Ṛk beginning सांतपना इदं (*sāṃtapanā idaṃ*) (the 9th Ṛk) as the Yājyā mantra. This is set out by the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra in the sūtra सांतपना इदं हविर्यो नो मरुतो अभि दुर्हृणायुः (*sāṃtapanā idaṃ haviryo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyuḥ*) (Ā. 2-18).

#### Ṛk 9

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> सांत॑पना इ॒दं ह॒विर्मरु॑त॒स्तज्जु॑जुष्टन ।  
> यु॒ष्माको॒ती रि॑शादसः ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> सांतपनाः । इदं । हविः । मरुतः । तत् । जुजुष्टन ।  
> युष्माक । ऊती । रिशादसः ॥ ९ ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> सांतपनाः शत्रूणां संतापका हे मरुतः इदं प्रत्यक्षेणोपलभ्यमानं हविर्युष्मभ्यं कल्पितमिति शेषः । हे रिशादसो रिशतां हिंसतामसितारो रिशानामुत्तारो वा यूयं युष्माक युष्माकमूत्या रक्षया तत्तादृशं हविर्जुजुष्टन । सेवध्वं ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

*Sāntapanas* means tormentors of enemies: O Maruts, tormentors of foes, this oblation, perceived before our eyes, is prepared for you (this is the word to be supplied). O रिशादसः (*riśādasaḥ*), devourers of those who injure (रिशतां (*riśatāṃ*)), or those who bring the injurers across; you, with your protection (युष्माकमूत्या (*yuṣmākamūtyā*)), enjoy such an oblation (जुजुष्टन (*jujuṣṭana*) = serve, partake).

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- सांतपनाः (*sāṃtapanāḥ*)—O destroyers of enemies
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- इदं हविः (*idaṃ haviḥ*)—this oblation is offered with you in view
- रिशादसः (*riśādasaḥ*)—you who destroy enemies
- युष्माकं (*yuṣmākaṃ*)—your
- ऊती (*ūtī*)—together with the protections
- तत् (*tat*)—that oblation
- जुजुष्टन (*jujuṣṭana*)—partake of

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, destroyers of enemies, this oblation is offered with you in view. You who destroy enemies, together with your protections, partake of it.

##### English translation
Maruts, destroyers of foes, this oblation is designed for you : do you,
who are the devourers of enemies, (coming) with your protections, graciously
accept it.

### Printed p. 392
#### Ṛk 10

##### ॥ संहितापाठः ॥ (Saṃhitā-pāṭha)

> गृह॑मेधास॒ आ ग॑त॒ मरु॑तो॒ माप॑ भूतन ।  
> यु॒ष्माको॒ती सु॑दानवः ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ पदपाठः ॥ (Pada-pāṭha)

> गृहमेधासः । आ । गत । मरुतः । मा । अप । भूतन ।  
> युष्माक । ऊती । सुदानवः ॥ १० ॥

##### ॥ सायणभाष्यम् ॥ (Sāyaṇa-bhāṣya)

> गृहमेधास इति गृहमेधीयस्य हविषोऽनुवाक्या । सूत्रितं च । गृहमेधास आ गत प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि । आ. २-१८ । इति ॥
> गृहमेधासो गृहे क्रियमाणो यज्ञो येषां ते सुदानवः शोभनदाना हे मरुतः यूयं युष्माक युष्माकमूत्या रक्षया युक्ता आ गत । अस्मदीयं यज्ञं प्रत्यागच्छत । हे मरुतः माप भूतन । अपगता मा भवत ॥ भू प्राप्ताविति धातोः ॥

##### Gist of the bhāṣya

गृहमेधासः (*gṛhamedhāsaḥ*) is the Anuvākyā for the oblation of the Gṛhamedhīya offering. It is laid down in the sūtra गृहमेधास आ गत प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि (*gṛhamedhāsa ā gata pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi*) (Ā. 2-18). Those whose sacrifice is performed in the house are गृहमेधासः (*gṛhamedhāsaḥ*); सुदानवः (*sudānavaḥ*) are those of good gifts. O Maruts, you, accompanied by your protection (युष्माकमूत्या रक्षया (*yuṣmākamūtyā rakṣayā*)), come (आ गत (*ā gata*)): come to our sacrifice. O Maruts, माप भूतन (*māpa bhūtana*): do not be gone away. The verb is from the root भू (*bhū*) in the sense of "to reach".

##### प्रतिपदार्थ (Pratipadārtha)

- गृहमेधासः (*gṛhamedhāsaḥ*)—worthy of worship in the house
- सुदानवः (*sudānavaḥ*)—excellent givers
- मरुतः (*marutaḥ*)—O Maruts
- युष्माकं (*yuṣmākaṃ*)—your
- ऊती (*ūtī*)—with protections
- आ गत (*ā gata*)—come
- माप भूतन (*māpa bhūtana*)—do not leave us and go elsewhere

##### भावार्थ (Bhāvārtha)

O Maruts, excellent recipients of worship in the house and excellent givers, come with your protections. Do not leave us and go elsewhere.

##### English translation
Objects of domestic worship, munificent Maruts, come with your
protections : go not away.

##### विशेषविषयगळु (Special Topics)

In the Gṛhamedhīya offering, this Ṛk beginning गृहमेधासः (*gṛhamedhāsaḥ*) is to be recited as the Anuvākyā mantra while the oblation is offered. It is applied by the Āśvalāyana Śrauta Sūtra in the sūtra गृहमेधास आगत प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि (*gṛhamedhāsa āgata pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi*) (Ā. 2-18).
